supporting_observations.claim: WS-NKIM-01 made repeated TCP connections to the explicit proxy at 10.53.20.30:8080 from 13:40:40 through 14:10:39 UTC. The observed intervals vary, including approximately five-minute gaps and shorter gaps.

The available records identify the proxy endpoint and connection byte counts, but do not identify the destinations or originating processes for those repeated connections. They therefore do not establish whether the sessions were malicious or an approved updater such as CaseBinder.

known_telemetry_limitations: The repeated-connection records are Zeek TCP connection summaries to the proxy; they do not show the CONNECT hostname, proxy user agent, or proxy action for those sessions.
No supplied endpoint process-to-network record attributes the repeated proxy connections to a particular application.
The available records do not include decrypted HTTPS content or enough information to determine what was transferred.
claims_not_established: The destination hostnames and services reached through the repeated proxy connections.
Whether the traffic was generated by CaseBinder's approved updater or another application.
Whether the connections transferred data of security significance or were part of ordinary update checks.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve proxy CONNECT/access records for WS-NKIM-01 around 13:30–14:10 UTC, including destination hostname, user agent, action, and byte counts.
Correlate the proxy sessions with endpoint process/network telemetry, including executable path, user, and process start time.
Check CaseBinder updater execution and update logs for the same period, and verify the updater binary and its signature.
unrelated_findings: At 13:20:27 UTC, before the alert window, WS-NKIM-01 made a successful proxy tunnel to clients6.google.com with user agent GoogleDriveFS/97.0.1.0. Google Drive is not listed among the approved services; track separately. (T145-00001)
